checks.detail: Before any analysis output directory is created, main requires complete fit_status with protected_parents_exact, fit_controller.exit0, and INTAKE. Every intake member size/SHA is checked. The already-reviewed collector writes INTAKE only after completed successful controller, exact tar membership/content validation and successful remote exit. The controller marks complete only after all six sequential initial_formal/train/formal commands return0.

Each of four arm/stage results requires PASS receipt,9508 rows/formal_rows, rows-file SHA, exact row_ids0..9507 and native hit totals matching receipt. Ordered NPZ row_ids cover9508 exactly; scores/reference_valid have(n,256) shape; each prior/reference/final array has(n,256,6), finite values and positive dimensions. CPU float64 IoU is computed for all candidates against stored GT. All256 oracle counts and selected/oracle threshold disagreements are explicitly reported. Initial final/reference arrays must be exactly equal.

Every current result pairs with the old retained9508 reference on row_id, scan_id, target_id, root_box and point_sha256. Array GT and selected boxes must equal the row-level GT/boxes. Selected query score must be a native maximum. Cross-arm and within-arm initial-to-formal comparisons repeat pairing; selected-query changes are reported rather than silently assumed absent.

Each arm requires complete3723-step/29778-row fit receipt, fresh optimizer, frozen parent/R,10 states/456102 parameters, lambda0 or1 and unchanged extra weight1. Training logs require steps1..3723,29778 unique row IDs, finalB2 and identical per-update row sequences across arms. Keep loss and match/additional/degradation occurrence totals remain descriptive.

Old reference path is retained fused_mask_reference/initial_formal rows, not retired4511. Hits5598/4848 are asserted; parent candidate is explicitly step0/zero_update_architecture with historical hidden-update count preserved. Old reference file SHA40672da53d767bc2262fa280a9904589c813a98b0c419d1cbdac161378144a23 matches the previously independently recounted stable input. No old checkpoint is opened.

Lexicographic key is(joint5620/4764 gate, strict hits, wide hits, protected-parent flag). Thus any joint-pass candidate precedes all failures; within a gate class strict then wide determines order, and the old protected parent wins only when both hit counts tie. If no candidate jointly passes, the same strict/wide order applies to all. The two gate metrics are read from one candidate row; no checkpoint-column splice occurs.

same_checkpoint_scan_gate_passed is separate from three_effective_modules_established=False. Each candidate retains step0-versus3723 status; both own-initial adaptation and same-budget arm comparison are emitted. fresh_terminal_audit_pending and selected_checkpoint_restore_pending remain true and weight_retention_executed false. Metric selection is not a three-module result, restore receipt or deletion action.

Actual preparer is W/prepare_closed_analysis.py, not postrun/prepare_closed_analysis.py. Its bounded source transformations update arms, old reference, weights, gate and selection rule. Read-only diff confirms actual generated analyzer differs from prior reviewed analyzer in those intended sections. Preparer only compiles/writes the draft; analyzer only consumes local artifacts and writes analysis/SUMMARY.json.
